Download **AutobahnRush.apk** below, open it on your Android phone and allow installing apps from this source when asked.

- Far more to explore off the Autobahn: wider roads with more room, side roads on both sides and branching off each other, muddy Waldwege through forests, and off-road areas with rocks, mud and water; hunting stands, hay bales and lakes
- Real off-road feel: the car bounces over ruts, splashes through puddles and slides in mud
- Steering: much less drifting (braking into a bend no longer spins the car), more direct steering with more lock on country roads, and no more pull to the left on exit ramps; the Autobahn steering is unchanged
- Polizei: first a polite stop (blue lights, BITTE FOLGEN, pull over behind them for a ticket), then a chase with siren and boxing in if you ignore it, then a rough Großfahndung if you keep running

If no release key is configured yet (see docs/ANDROID.md), the APK is debug-signed and an update may need the old version uninstalled first.
